text: 金十数据7月18日讯，2026年7月18日，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在上海会见来华出席世界人工智能大会的莱索托外交大臣陶。王毅欢迎陶来华出席大会并代表莱政府签署成立世界人工智能合作组织协定。王毅表示，在人工智能发展中，任何国家都不应掉队，尤其是发展中国家，理应享有科技发展的正当权利。中方推动成立世界人工智能合作组织，就是为提升全球南方国家的能力建设，各国共迎新科技时代潮流，实现人工智能向善向上，造福全人类。中国外交历来坚持大小国家一律平等。中莱面积和体量不同，但始终是相互信任、相互支持的战略伙伴。中方将继续支持莱维护主权、安全和发展利益，鼓励中方
text_en: Jin10 Data, July 18. On July 18, 2026, Wang Yi, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Minister of Foreign Affairs, met in Shanghai with Tso, Foreign Minister of Lesotho, who was attending the World AI Conference. Wang Yi welcomed Tso's visit to China for the conference and to sign the agreement on behalf of the Lesotho government to establish a World AI Cooperation Organization. Wang Yi stated that no country should be left behind in AI development, especially developing countries, which have the legitimate right to enjoy technological progress. China's push to establish the World AI Cooperation Organization aims to enhance the capacity building of Global South countries, enabling all nations to embrace the new technological era, achieve beneficial and ethical AI, and benefit all of humanity. Chinese diplomacy has always adhered to equality among all countries regardless of size. Though China and Lesotho differ in area and scale, they have always been strategic partners of mutual trust and support.
